Delete or downgrade false-alarm pages today.

1. **1-hr alert audit (today):** Pull last 4 wks of pages (~40 events). No immediate human action required -> delete, raise threshold/duration, or demote to business-hrs ticket/Slack. Page strictly on urgent user-facing symptoms (downtime, 5xx spikes, fast SLO burn), never raw causes (CPU, RAM, disk) w/o active user impact.
2. **0% sprint work on shift:** Pull on-call off feature delivery immediately. Job on shift = answer pages + permanently fix/automate noisy triggers. Grant unilateral authority to mute broken monitors mid-shift.
3. **Automatic sleep recovery:** Overnight page = mandatory late start or comp hrs next day w/o manager approval.
4. **15-min handoff gate:** At weekly swap, review every page from prior shift; tune or delete every false alarm before handoff closes.

Keep 1-wk rotation as-is. 1 wk on / 5 wks off is sustainable once volume drops to <2 actionable pages/wk, changing shift length w/o cutting noise just redistributes burnout.
